// A wiper whose collection list lives in an arbitrarily-named constant, and
// which correctly claims its own emulator project.
process.env.NODE_ENV = 'local';
process.env.FIRESTORE_TEST_NAMESPACE = 'fixture';

const { db } = require('../../src/utils/firebase');
const { clearCollection } = require('../helpers/firebase-emulator');

const COLLECTIONS_TO_WIPE = ['users', 'rooms', 'deviceBans'];

beforeEach(async () => {
  for (const collection of COLLECTIONS_TO_WIPE) await clearCollection(db, collection);
});
